title: Basketball
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office engages in a friendly basketball game organized by Michael, who emphasizes stress relief and character lessons through sports. The episode features team organization, playful banter, disputes over fouls, and Michael's reflections on the importance of character and life lessons learned from the game.

main_threads.thread: Michael organizes and participates in a basketball game with office staff, emphasizing stress relief and character lessons.
